title: Dedicated capacity weekly prep - 2026-03-05
content:
Purpose: quick sync prep for the weekly dedicated-capacity meeting. Focus: GPU pool forecast, upcoming reservation renewals, and proposed autoscaling tweaks.

Agenda (15-20m):
- Quick data snapshot (5m) - utilization / headroom by pool
- Reservations & renewals (5m) - what expires this quarter
- Autoscaling policy changes proposal (5m)
- Action items + owners (2-5m)

Data snapshot (latest numbers from metrics query run 2026-03-05 06:30 PT):
- total dedicated GPUs: 1,120 (NVIDIA A100/A10 mix)
- active GPU VMs: 1,040 -> overall utilization (vGPU allocation) ~82.1%
- 95th p99 token latency SLO headroom: adequate for most routes, but high tail on long-seq generation routes (chat-long)
- burstable_pools: 120 GPUs reserved for burst; currently 78% used during peak windows
- predicted growth for next 30 days: +6-9% committed throughput based on sales pipeline (approx +70-100 GPUs needed)

Forecast assumptions:
- Model mix: ~60% gen models (longer sequences), 25% chat-short, 15% embeddings/batch jobs
- Seasonality: end-of-quarter demos increase peak utilization on weekdays 9-18PT
- New customers onboarding mid-March will add ~25 sustained QPS for generation routes

Reservations & contracts (expirations / renewals):
- 200 A100s reserved under contract A-2024-11 expire 2026-04-15 -> renewal conversation needed with sales/finance by 2026-03-20
- 80 A10 reservations auto-renew (no action)
- 64 GPUs from partner pool (region eu-west) show billing mismatch - open ticket with partner (JIRA-4821)

Autoscaling policy notes (proposal):
- Current scaling policy: scale-up threshold CPU/gpu-queue 70% sustained 3m; scale-down after 10m idle
- Problem: slow scale-up for long-seq workloads (KV cache warmup causes sequence-length spikes) -> need faster warmup path
- Proposal A: add predictive scale buffer based on scheduled demos / high-confidence bookings (provision +10-15% headroom 30m before scheduled event)
- Proposal B: reduce scale-up sustained window from 3m -> 90s for generation pools but keep scale-down at 8m to avoid oscillation
- Proposal C: dynamic autoscale per-route using traffic fingerprints (if route id in top-10 heavy routes, use more aggressive scaling)
- Risk: more aggressive scale-up increases cost; need to pair with short-term predictive batching and KV pre-warm to reduce wasted tokens

Quick capacity tradeoffs:
- If we renew 200 A100s, immediate headroom for next quarter but higher committed spend - run cost projection vs. on-demand mix
- If we rely on autoscaling + burst pool, risk of degraded p99 for long-seq during spikes

Open questions for today's sync / things to resolve:
- Sales: confirm probability and onboarding dates for the two demo customers (affects +70-100 GPU ask) - ask Julie/AM to confirm by 2026-03-12
- Finance: acceptable commit term for A100 renewal (6 vs 12 months) and expected discount thresholds
- SRE/serving-runtime: feasibility and timeline for reducing scale-up sustained window to 90s without causing thrash
- Partner billing mismatch: need update from partner team on JIRA-4821 before renewals decision

Action items (owner / due):
- Ryan W: run cost vs on-demand simulation for renewing 200 A100s (include 6m and 12m scenarios). Due 2026-03-12.
- Alex M: prototype autoscale change (90s scale-up) on staging for generation pools and collect p99/p95 impact. Due 2026-03-10.
- Hannah K: reach out to sales contacts to confirm onboarding schedules for two demo customers. Due 2026-03-09.
- Maya P (me): consolidate results and recommendation doc for exec review + draft email to finance. Due 2026-03-16.
- Infra: escalate partner billing (JIRA-4821) and provide reconciliation by 2026-03-11.

Notes to self / talking points:
- Emphasize tradeoff: committed capacity reduces unit cost and simplifies latency SLOs, but increases cash outlay and reduces flexibility for model mix changes
- Recommend hybrid: short-term partial renewal (100-120 A100) + aggressive autoscale tuning + predictive reserve for scheduled events. Present cost delta in meeting.
- If autoscale prototype shows minimal p99 regression, prefer less commit. If p99 degrades significantly, push for larger renewal.

Follow-up: after meeting, update this doc with decisions and move to final state; push summary + action list to #eng-dedicated-capacity Slack channel and tag finance/sales contacts.

Scratch / raw notes:
- query used: metrics/dedicated/pool_utilization?window=30d&group=pool_type (ran 06:30 PT)
- manual check: eu-west partner invoices look off by ~64 GPUs last month
- reminder: check with obs team about cost allocation tags for new reserved instances (so customers show correct chargeback)

End of prep.
